Participating in continuing education and training to remain current on best practices, learn new programming languages, and better assist other team members.
  
Consulting with engineering staff to evaluate software\-hardware interfaces and develop specifications and performance requirements
  
Document and demonstrate solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code
  
Documenting very necessary details and reports in a formal way for proper understanding of software from client proposal to implementation
  
Ensure good quality of interaction with customer w.r.t. e\-mail content, fault report tracking, voice calls, business etiquette etc
  
Timely Response to customer requests and no instances of complaints either internally or externally

Deliver
  
  

No. Performance Parameter Measure
  
1\. Continuous Integration, Deployment \& Monitoring of Software 100% error free on boarding \& implementation, throughput %, Adherence to the schedule/ release plan

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner
jobs.description:
**About Techdome**
------------------


Techdome is a product\-driven technology company building AI\-first solutions across Healthcare, FinTech, HRTech, Payments, and Enterprise SaaS. We believe Product Owners should do more than manage backlogs they should own customer outcomes, drive product strategy, and bridge the gap between business and technology to build products that create real impact.**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for a **Technical Product Owner** with a strong engineering mindset and experience managing customer\-facing B2C products. In this role, you'll own the product lifecycle end\-to\-end from product discovery and roadmap planning to execution, launch, and continuous improvement. You'll work closely with Founders, Engineering, Design, QA, and Business teams to deliver scalable, AI\-powered products that solve real customer problems.**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Product Ownership**

* Own product features from ideation through development, launch, and continuous enhancement.
* Define product vision, roadmap, feature prioritization, and release plans aligned with business goals.
* Gather, analyze, and prioritize customer, business, and technical requirements.

### **Product Planning \& Documentation**

* Create and maintain PRDs, BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Epics, Acceptance Criteria, Process Flows, and Product Backlogs.
* Translate business requirements into clear, actionable engineering deliverables.
* Ensure product documentation remains accurate and up to date throughout the development lifecycle.

### **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Engineering teams on APIs, integrations, solution design, technical feasibility, and architecture discussions.
* Partner with UX/UI teams to deliver intuitive and customer\-centric user experiences.
* Collaborate with QA, Operations, and Business teams to ensure successful product releases.

### **Agile Delivery**

* Lead Sprint Planning, Backlog Grooming, Sprint Reviews, UAT, and Release Planning.
* Monitor delivery timelines, remove blockers, and ensure high\-quality product releases.
* Drive continuous product improvements based on customer feedback and product analytics.

**AI\-First Product Management**
--------------------------------


At Techdome, AI is an integral part of product development and decision\-making.
We're looking for Product Owners who actively leverage AI to improve research, documentation, planning, and productivity.
Hands\-on experience with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Perplexity, Notion AI, or similar AI platforms is highly preferred.
Experience using AI for:* Product research and competitive analysis
* Requirement gathering and documentation
* PRDs, User Stories, and Acceptance Criteria
* Roadmap planning and feature prioritization
* Meeting summaries and stakeholder communication
* Workflow automation and productivity enhancement

**Required Skills**
-------------------

* 3\+ years of experience as a Technical Product Owner, Product Manager, or Technical Business Analyst.
* Experience owning B2C digital products from ideation to production.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, SDLC, Product Lifecycle Management, Sprint Planning, Backlog Management, and Release Management.
* Hands\-on experience creating product documentation, including PRDs, BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Epics, and Acceptance Criteria.
* Experience with JIRA, Confluence, and modern collaboration tools.
* Good understanding of REST APIs, SQL, Databases, System Integrations, Cloud Fundamentals, and Technical Architecture.
* Strong analytical, stakeholder management, communication, and decision\-making skills.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Customer\-first mindset with a passion for solving real business problems.
* Ability to balance customer needs, business priorities, and technical feasibility.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to drive products independently.
* Data\-driven decision\-making using customer insights, analytics, and market research.
* Excellent collaboration skills across Engineering, Design, Business, and Leadership teams.
* Continuous learner with an interest in AI, emerging technologies, and product innovation.

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Experience with AI\-powered products or SaaS platforms.
* Exposure to Product Analytics tools such as Mixpanel, GA4, or Amplitude.
* Knowledge of Payments, Healthcare, FinTech, HRTech, or Enterprise SaaS domains.
* Product strategy, go\-to\-market planning, and customer journey mapping.

**Interview Process**
---------------------

* AI Interview (JustInterview.ai)
* Technical \& Functional Discussion
* Leadership Discussion.

jobs.description:
**Overview**  

Are you interested in working for one of the most exciting teams at Microsoft owning a fundamental piece of the Azure cloud? Looking for a new challenge to demonstrate your expertise in building systems at massive scale with extremely high availability (100% SLA)? Then look no further than the Azure DNS Team. We are looking for an engineer with deep technical expertise, a curiosity\-driven mindset, and a strong sense of ownership. You’ll work on globally distributed, scalable, and low\-latency services that serve critical workloads across the globe.  

  

The Azure DNS team is looking for a Principal Software Engineer with deep technical expertise, a curiosity\-driven mindset, and a strong sense of ownership. You will work to design and implement a globally distributed, scalable and low latency super service that provides DNS capabilities for the most critical domains in the world. The developer will work with a team of other software engineers to design and implement various components that constitute this state\-of\-the\-art distributed systems solution and ensure a timely execution of the components with high quality \- think of 1 billion records at very low latencies. Running DNS at such scale requires building systems that are resilient to multiple failure patterns with continuous investments in quality of service.  

  

 Azure DNS also enables other innovations in Azure by providing a robust platform for resource naming across all Azure features like Storage, Software Defined Networking, databases and Azure Compute. This provides an enormous learning opportunity to build integrated solutions with other Azure services. This team also owns building services for DDoS protection of DNS service and you will play a key role in ensuring a smooth integration of core DNS services with the DDoS solutions. In our work environment, you will find very friendly co\-workers eager to welcome you to the team and help you along the way. We foster and reward collaboration as a key part of our culture and we look forward to meeting you!

jobs.description:
Job Title Support Analyst IT – Quality
   

  

 Location  Hyderabad, India
   

  

 Job Summary  We are seeking a skilled Support Analyst in Quality Portfolio to provide reliable application support and operational excellence for key Quality IT systems.
   

  

 This role focuses on supporting and maintaining specialized applications critical to quality management, laboratory operations, regulatory compliance, and sustainability initiatives across supply chain and manufacturing processes.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings strong technical support expertise, hands\-on knowledge of LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System), Polarion (Application Lifecycle Management / Quality Assurance platform), and Sustainability applications (e.g., ESG tracking, waste/carbon management tools, or environmental compliance systems), to ensure system availability, user satisfaction, data integrity, and minimal disruption to business operations.
   

  

 The position requires proactive issue resolution, user training, and collaboration with business stakeholders and IT teams—without involvement in software development, testing, or engineering tasks. Reporting to the Quality IT Delivery Lead and collaborating with onshore portfolio leadership, the analyst will contribute to stable, compliant, and efficient Quality IT operations.
   

  

 This role should be working 4 days a week onshore from Hyderabad MTIC office and provides support on shift basis to covers 24x7 support for critical Quality applications.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Provide first and second\-level support for LIMS, Polarion, and Sustainability applications troubleshoot incidents, resolve user queries, perform root\-cause analysis, and implement fixes or workarounds in a timely manner.
* Monitor system health, performance, and alerts; perform routine maintenance, configuration updates, user access management, and patch/application of updates to ensure high availability and compliance.
* Manage user support lifecycle respond to tickets (via ServiceNow/JIRA/Service Desk), prioritize issues based on business impact, escalate complex problems, and track resolution to closure.

* Collaborate with vendors/support teams (e.g., Siemens for Polarion, LIMS providers) for advanced troubleshooting, enhancements, or escalations.
* Contribute to knowledge base maintenance, documentation of configurations/workflows, and continuous improvement initiatives (e.g., reducing recurring incidents, optimizing user experience).
* Participate in change management processes assess impact of updates, coordinate testing/validation (non\-technical), and support go\-live activities.
* Track support metrics (ticket volume, resolution time, user satisfaction) and report trends to leadership for proactive improvements.


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Life Sciences, Supply Chain, or related field.
* 4\+ years of experience in IT application support, preferably in Quality, Laboratory, Compliance, or Manufacturing environments.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge and support experience with
* LIMS (e.g., sample management, workflow automation, data integrity in lab/quality processes).
* Polarion (ALM/QA platform for requirements, test management, traceability, compliance/audit support).
* Sustainability applications (e.g., tools for ESG reporting, carbon/waste tracking, environmental compliance in supply chain/manufacturing).
* Solid understanding of ITIL processes (incident, problem, change management) and ticketing tools (ServiceNow, JIRA).
* Excellent problem\-solving, communication, and customer service skills for interacting with global business users.
* Experience in regulated industries (consumer goods, pharma, manufacturing) with focus on compliance and data governance.


**Preferred Skills \& Attributes**
* Familiarity with integration points between LIMS, Polarion, and other Quality/ERP/Sustainability systems.
* Basic scripting/SQL knowledge for querying data or generating reports (not development).
* Certifications ITIL Foundation, Polarion Administrator/User, LIMS\-related training, or equivalent.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, global matrix environment with cross\-time\-zone support needs.


 This role is vital for maintaining reliable, compliant Quality IT operations—ensuring LIMS drives efficient lab workflows, Polarion enables robust QA/traceability, and Sustainability applications support environmental goals—while delivering exceptional user support and contributing to overall Quality transformation.

**Job Description**
**Job Purpose**
 The Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (ICE) presents a unique opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technology and address complex business challenges in the financial sector. The ICE Senior Test Engineer position plays a key role in testing and delivering trading, listing, compliance and surveillance applications, while supporting all stages of the Software Development Life\-Cycle (SDLC). The successful candidate will be able to multitask in a dynamic team\-based environment, while demonstrating strong problem\-solving, extensive technical skills, decision\-making abilities and the highest level of professionalism. The candidate is also expected to have excellent business knowledge/experience.
   

  

 We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Test Engineer with expertise in Options Derivatives with FIX Protocol to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Options, Capital Markets and FIX Protocol. This role focuses on ensuring the quality of software applications, particularly related to options trading platforms. This includes designing and executing test scenarios and test cases, identifying and reporting bugs, and collaborating with developers to resolve issues and ensure a high\-quality user experience. They also work to improve testing processes and tools.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and implement comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts to cover functional, performance, and usability aspects of the options trading platform.
* Identify, document, and report software defects using bug tracking systems, and collaborate with developers to resolve them.
* Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure quality throughout the development lifecycle.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of automated tests to improve testing efficiency and coverage.
* Identify and implement opportunities for process improvements in the test automation lifecycle.
* Ensure that new features or bug fixes do not negatively impact existing functionality.
* Be an active participant in planning and designing product features with the ability to view the product from a customer perspective.
* Collaborate with cross functional teams involved in product delivery.
* Develop, update, maintain and execute automated tests.
* Review and triage test failures and verify fixes.
* Maintain clear and concise documentation of test plans, test cases, test results, and bug reports.
* Participate in on\-call rotations, driving bug isolation and helping restore the service.
* Work with minimum of technical supervision.
* Stay current with the latest engineering technologies and best practices.


**Knowledge And Experience**
* Solid hands\-on experience in the Options derivatives domain, including strong knowledge of options trading workflows, order types, and lifecycle management, coupled with proven expertise in FIX protocol messaging for order entry, execution, and drop\-copy session handling.
* Proficient in Linux command\-line usage, including log navigation, file management, process monitoring, and scripting for test environment setup and troubleshooting.
* Hands\-on experience writing and executing SQL queries for test data validation, result verification, and database state analysis across QA environments.
* Deep understanding of software testing methodologies and best practices, with the ability to design comprehensive test strategies for complex trading systems.
* Proven experience across a range of testing techniques including functional, regression, integration, and end\-to\-end testing within financial or trading application environments.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with sharp attention to detail, particularly in identifying edge cases and defects within high\-throughput trading systems.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and business teams in a fast\-paced environment.
* Familiarity with defect tracking and project management tools such as Jira, with experience managing full bug lifecycle from identification through resolution verification.
* Experience leveraging AI tools to enhance testing productivity, including automated test case generation, log analysis, root cause investigation of test failures, and intelligent defect triage.


**Preferred Knowledge And Experience**
* Experience with other trading and financial applications is a plus.
* Good knowledge of FIX protocol is a plus.
* Experience with supporting production changes, UAT testing and debugging prod issues.
* Results Driven: Drive, focus and commitment to deliver results that meet the requirements of internal customers along with the passion for quality and getting the right results in the right way. Ability to work tight schedules/deadlines and multitask.

**Product Owner — Tax**
 InvoiceCloud is a fast\-growing fintech company with an award\-winning culture and a leading disruptor in the electronic bill presentment and payment (EBPP) space. Serving more than 3,200 customers across the utility, government, and insurance industries, InvoiceCloud’s secure and innovative SaaS platform enhances the customer experience, driving higher digital payment, AutoPay, and paperless adoption rates. By switching to InvoiceCloud, clients can improve customer engagement and satisfaction while lowering costs, accelerating payments, and reducing staff workloads. To learn more, visit InvoiceCloud.com.
   

  

**Job Details**
 The Product Owner will lead one dedicated scrum team focused on advancing InvoiceCloud’s capabilities for our Tax customers. This includes improving tax bill presentment, building payment workflows tailored to tax\-specific scenarios such as partial payments and installment plans, strengthening integrations with municipal tax and county assessor systems, and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements unique to tax billing. The PO will also drive initiatives to increase digital adoption and conversion rates among tax customers.
   

  

 The PO will own the team backlog, drive iterative execution, and closely monitor product performance to ensure shipped work delivers measurable customer and business value, while partnering with the Product Manager to maintain alignment with broader product strategy.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Backlog Ownership \& Prioritization**
* Maintain a clear, outcome\-aligned backlog for the scrum team, ensuring each item is well\-defined, technically feasible, and tied to a specific customer or business problem.
* Translate customer needs, stakeholder input, and data insights into user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Keep at least three sprints of groomed, prioritized work consistently prepared so the team can plan ahead without interruption.
* Make day\-to\-day decisions that unblock engineering and maintain delivery velocity.
* Ensure the team understands the “why” behind priorities and how work contributes to tax billing outcomes and biller operational efficiency.


**Execution \& Delivery**
* Lead sprint planning, backlog refinement, and sprint reviews with precision and preparation.
* Ensure shipped features meet acceptance criteria, quality standards, and intended use cases.
* Partner with engineering and UX to deliver incremental improvements rather than large, risky releases.


**Experimentation \& Analytics**
* Monitor released features, track key performance indicators, and drive corrective actions when results fall short.
* Use product analytics, behavioral data, and qualitative input to understand how tax billers and their payers interact with the platform.


**Customer \& Workflow Understanding**
* Develop deep understanding of tax billing workflows, biller pain points, and payer usage patterns.
* Represent customer needs during product discussions and decision\-making.
* Participate in customer interviews, usability sessions, and frontline team conversations to stay grounded in real\-world experience.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Work with business stakeholders, engineering, design, data, and support teams to ensure alignment and smooth execution.
* Partner with the Product Manager to keep the roadmap, vision, and team\-level priorities tightly connected.
* Collaborate with operations and enablement teams to support adoption and rollout of new tax vertical capabilities.


**Requirements**
**Education**
* BE/BTech degree required; technical, business, or quantitative fields preferred.


**Experience**
* 3–5 years as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or related product role in a SaaS environment.
* Hands\-on experience with Agile/Scrum teams; CSPO or similar certification preferred.
* Familiarity with government or tax billing systems and workflows is a plus.


**Skills**
* Strong backlog management and sprint execution skills; deeply familiar with Agile/Scrum team operation.
* Proven ability to articulate customer problems, define user stories, and translate requirements into actionable work.
* Analytical thinker who uses data to justify priorities and evaluate the impact of shipped features.
* Clear communicator with the discipline to document decisions, acceptance criteria, and changes precisely.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Data Quality \& AI Readiness Product Analyst


Job Location: Hyderabad Hub


Job Type: Fulltime/Permanent

***About the Job***


As a Data Quality \& AI Readiness Product Analyst within the MDM Jobs/Skills Taxonomy team — part of Data Governance \& Master Data Management — you will sit at the intersection of data governance, Human Capital technology, and process excellence. You will be a critical enabler of Sanofi's enterprise\-wide skills\-based organization initiative, ensuring that the skills and jobs data powering Workday's Skills Cloud, Career Hub, and AI\-driven talent matching is trusted, complete, and AI\-ready.


You will drive proactive risk management, resolve global data quality issues, and ensure our Human Capital data meets Sanofi's AI\-Ready Data Framework standards — making it fit to power both operational decisions and the AI\-driven innovation that underpins our mission to chase the miracles of science.

**Main responsibilities**

*1\. Investigation \& Diagnosis*

* Assess and document downstream impact of Skills and Job Architecture data quality issues across payroll processing, management reporting, third\-party integrations, and AI/machine learning model inputs
* Monitor ongoing adoption of global data standards across regions, business units, and functional teams, with particular focus on Skills and Job Architecture taxonomy data consistency in Workday — proactively detecting and flagging the re\-introduction of local deviations, non\-standard values, or workarounds
* Conduct structured root cause analyses to distinguish isolated errors from systemic issues requiring process or configuration\-level intervention
* Use Python scripting and SQL to conduct deep\-dive data profiling and root cause investigations across Workday and Snowflake data assets
* Build reusable investigation toolkits and diagnostic scripts to accelerate root cause analysis and reduce time\-to\-resolution across recurring issue patterns
* Support organizational cloning and data standardization initiatives through fact\-based investigation, evidence gathering, and data profiling — ensuring skills data is structured and clean for AI model consumption
* Execute Data Analysis and Mapping for Workday Optimization and other relevant projects

*2\. Data Quality Engineering \& Automation*

* Design and build automated Skills and Job Architecture data quality pipelines using Python to validate, profile, and monitor at scale, integrated into the Data Foundation (Snowflake)
* Contribute to the design and implementation of data observability practices — including data lineage tracking, freshness monitoring, and schema validation — across the Skills and Job Architecture data domains
* Build automated monitoring dashboards (e.g., Power BI) and alerting mechanisms to proactively surface data quality deviations before they impact downstream systems, enabling early resolution of cloning/standardization conflicts

*3\. Data Remediation \& Execution*

* Develop and execute Python\-based remediation scripts and automated correction workflows reducing reliance on manual EIB loads where technically feasible and accelerating remediation
* Prepare, validate, and execute data correction actions and remediation loads (EIB, manual)
* Partner closely with the Global Process Owner (GPO) and Workday Technology teams to define and implement structural fixes — whether through process redesign, system configuration changes, or governance policy updates — and deliver measurable improvement in priority data quality fields

*4\. Governance, Risk \& Stakeholder Collaboration*

* Serve as a bridge between data operations and technical teams, translating business data quality requirements into actionable technical specifications aligned with MDM standards
* Identify and escalate risks to data consistency, AI readiness, and global reporting accuracy at the earliest possible stage
* Contribute to AI\-Ready Data KPI scoring for the relevant data assets, including DQ rule coverage, quality scoring in Informatica CDGC, metadata cataloging, and data access classification

***About You***

 *Required Education, Experience \& Skills*

* Degree in Information Systems, Data Engineering, Computer Science, Data Management, or a related field
* 3–5 years of experience in data engineering, data quality, data governance, or a related analytical/technical role
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience building data pipelines, validation frameworks, or automation scripts in Python
* Proven track record of conducting data investigations and delivering structured, actionable findings
* Experience working in a global, matrixed organization with cross\-functional stakeholders
* Strong SQL skills for data profiling, investigation, and validation across large\-scale HR datasets
* Experience with big data technologies such as Snowflake
* Experience building and maintaining ELT/ETL pipelines for data quality monitoring and remediation
* Familiarity with data remediation processes, including mass data loads and EIB (Enterprise Interface Builder) or equivalent
* Understanding of HR data domains: employee records, organizational structures, skills profiles, compensation, payroll inputs, and workforce reporting
* Experience with data quality platforms or monitoring tools (e.g., Informatica CDGC, Collibra, Ataccama, or similar)

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences industry
* Experience working with Workday HCM or comparable enterprise HR platforms is a strong plus — Workday certification or formal training valued but not required as the primary technical requirement
* Familiarity with Workday Skills Cloud, Career Hub and their underlying data structures
* Exposure to MLOps or AI/ML data pipeline engineering
* Certification in data governance, data quality management, or HR analytics
* Knowledge of GDPR, data privacy regulations, and their implications for HR data management

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
The Product Owner (PO) within Kroll’s Chief Data Office (CDO) is accountable for the end‑to‑end ownership, delivery, and adoption of enterprise data products. This role serves as the single point of accountability for product vision, stakeholder alignment, roadmap execution, and experience quality across assigned data domains.
   

  

 The Product Owner partners closely with
 **Business stakeholders, Data Engineering, BI/Reporting, Data Science, Governance, and Platform teams** 
 to ensure data products are reliable, intuitive, scalable, and aligned with Kroll’s strategic priorities. The role emphasizes
 **clarity of ownership, predictable delivery, and measurable business impact** 
 in a complex, enterprise data environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Ownership \& Accountability**
* Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for enterprise data, analytics, or AI product areas.
* Serve as the single point of accountability for product outcomes, delivery health, and user experience.
* Define and communicate product goals, success metrics, and value drivers to stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Ensure products operate with clear ownership, release discipline, and lifecycle management, behaving like true products—not one‑off projects.


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Business Alignment**
* Act as the primary interface between the CDO and business, finance, and functional leaders for assigned domains.
* Partner with stakeholders to prioritize demand, manage tradeoffs, and align delivery to business timelines.
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements without compromising data integrity or architectural standards.
* Establish and maintain trusted relationships that enable fast decision‑making and alignment.


**Backlog, Roadmap \& Delivery Management**
* Own and maintain a prioritized, well‑defined backlog with clear acceptance criteria and readiness standards.
* Work with Program Managers, Scrum Masters, and delivery teams to plan releases and manage dependencies.
* Balance short‑term delivery needs with long‑term product health, scalability, and maintainability.
* Surface risks, constraints, or scope trade‑offs early to enable leadership decisions.


**Governance, Quality \& Standards**
* Partner with Data Governance, Data Stewards, and Platform Owners to ensure:
+ Consistent KPI definitions and metric logic
+ Data quality, lineage, and trust standards
+ Alignment with enterprise data architecture and security policies

* Ensure products meet operational readiness standards prior to release and are supported post‑launch.


**Adoption, Value \& Continuous Improvement**
* Drive product adoption by ensuring solutions is intuitive, reliable, and aligned to real user workflows.
* Define and track usage, adoption, and value realization metrics.
* Collect feedback and iterate to continuously improve product experience and impact.
* Support leadership by providing a clear narrative on what is delivered, what value it creates, and what comes next.


**Required**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, Analytics, or Data‑centric roles.
* Proven ability to own roadmaps, backlogs, and stakeholder relationships in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of data, reporting, analytics, or BI platforms (e.g., Power BI, Databricks, data warehouses).
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models with engineering and analytics teams.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate between business objectives and technical execution.


**Preferred**
* Experience in a Chief Data Office, Analytics, or Enterprise Reporting organization.
* Familiarity with data governance, semantic models, KPI standardization, and self‑service analytics.
* Experience supporting finance, operations, or enterprise‑wide reporting domains.
* Prior experience working in a vendor‑heavy environment and helping transition to more internal ownership.


**Leadership Behaviors \& Expectations**
* Operates with clear ownership and accountability.
* Brings structure, clarity, and discipline to ambiguous problem spaces.
* Makes trade‑offs explicitly and escalates decisions appropriately.
* Focuses on outcomes and value, not just delivery.
* Trusted partner to both business leaders and technical teams.


**Why This Role Matters**
 The Product Owner is a
 **critical enabler of CDO’s product‑led operating model** 
 , ensuring that data and analytics investments deliver consistent, trusted, and measurable value to the firm—while reducing dependency on informal workarounds, fragmented ownership, and vendor‑driven execution.

jobs.title: Agentic Business Process Analyst
jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
 At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
   

  

**Job Description:**
**Role Overview**
 Crowe’s Microsoft Consulting Practice is hiring an Agentic Business Process Analyst to help clients rethink how work gets done in the AI era. This is not a traditional business analyst role focused only on documenting requirements, writing user stories, or mapping current\-state processes. This role is for someone who can diagnose business problems, understand root causes, redesign processes, and identify where AI agents, automation, data, and human judgment should come together.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is deeply functional, process\-oriented, and comfortable enough with technology to work side by side with engineers, architects, and client IT teams. This person should be able to bridge business and technology, helping clients move from legacy workflows to intelligent, agent\-enabled processes.
   

  

 This role also has an internal transformation mandate. The person will help upskill Crowe Consulting teams that may be used to traditional ERP, CRM, or business application delivery. They will help consultants develop a more modern mindset: start with problems, then processes, then technology.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Lead discovery sessions with clients to understand business goals, pain points, process breakdowns, data issues, user needs, controls, and operating constraints.
* Map end\-to\-end business processes, including inputs, outputs, roles, systems, decisions, handoffs, exceptions, controls, and performance measures.
* Diagnose root causes across people, process, data, and technology before recommending solutions.
* Identify opportunities for AI assistance, agentic augmentation, workflow orchestration, automation, knowledge retrieval, decision support, and process improvement.
* Partner with technical architects and engineers to translate process opportunities into solution designs, prototypes, functional specifications, user stories, and delivery roadmaps.
* Define business value measures for agentic solutions, such as time saved, cycle time reduction, first\-time\-right rate, SLA performance, adoption, override rate, CSAT, cost per transaction, revenue lift, and compliance improvement.
* Help clients decide where humans should stay in control, where AI should assist, and where agents can safely orchestrate or automate work.
* Support workshops, demos, process redesign sessions, executive presentations, and change management conversations.
* Create reusable playbooks, templates, process models, and training materials to help Crowe teams adopt an agentic business analysis approach.
* Coach Crowe consultants on how to move beyond legacy requirements gathering into diagnostic, value\-led, AI\-enabled transformation work.


**What Success Looks Like**
* You can walk into a messy client process and make sense of it quickly.
* You can separate symptoms from root causes.
* You know when the right answer is process redesign, data cleanup, integration, training, governance, automation, or AI.
* You can help clients and internal teams understand what agents should do, what humans should do, and how to measure whether the new process is better.
* You make technical teams sharper by giving them better process context, and you make business teams more confident by helping them understand what technology can realistically do.


**Required Experience**
* 6 or more years of experience as a business analyst, functional consultant, process consultant, product owner, transformation consultant, or similar role.
* Strong experience mapping, analyzing, and redesigning business processes.
* Experience working on enterprise technology implementations, preferably involving Microsoft Dynamics 365, CRM, ERP, Power Platform, data platforms, workflow automation, or related business applications.
* Ability to facilitate workshops with business users, technical teams, and senior stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of process metrics, business value measurement, operational KPIs, and adoption measures.
* Ability to write clear functional requirements, user stories, process flows, acceptance criteria, solution narratives, and executive\-ready recommendations.
* Comfort working with technical teams on AI, automation, data, integration, and system design topics.
* Ability to mentor other consultants and help teams adopt new ways of working.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience with Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, Customer Insights, Project Operations, Finance, or Supply Chain.
* Experience with Power Platform, Copilot Studio, process mining, business process catalogs, customer journey mapping, service design, or operating model transformation.
* Experience identifying AI use cases, automation candidates, decision support opportunities, or agentic process patterns.
* Experience in consulting or professional services.
* Exposure to responsible AI, governance, risk, compliance, controls, or regulated industry environments.


**Mindset we need**
 This person should not be a note\-taker or requirements scribe. They should be a transformation\-oriented business analyst who can challenge assumptions, ask better questions, and guide clients toward the right solution.

jobs.title: Business & Category Manager - Fasteners & Fittings
jobs.description:
Position Title: Business \& Category Manager \- Fasteners \& Fittings

Department: Business Development / New Category Setup \& Scaling

Job Summary:

The Business \& Category Manager \- Fasteners \& Fittings will own the P\&L for the Fasteners \& Fittings

business, from ground zero build\-out through scale\-up. This is not a conventional business

development role \- it is a business ownership role. The ideal candidate will independently drive export

\& domestic business development, own pricing strategy, and manage sourcing decisions for the

business, functioning as an internal entrepreneur responsible for growth, margins, and profitability.

This role requires a strong understanding of fasteners and fittings products, export markets, customer

acquisition, and supplier/sourcing dynamics, along with the maturity to make commercial trade\-offs

independently.

Key Responsibilities:

1\. Business Build\-Out \& P\&L Ownership:

o Build the Fasteners \& Fittings business from the ground up \- establishing customer

pipeline, supplier base, pricing framework, and operating processes. Own the business

P\&L, including revenue growth, margins, and overall profitability. Set the business strategy

and roadmap, and make independent decisions on which markets, customers, and

products to prioritize for growth. Act as the business owner rather than a functional

specialist \- balancing sales, sourcing, and pricing decisions to maximize outcomes.

2\. Exports Business Development:

o Identify, prospect, and develop new export customers for fasteners and fittings across

relevant geographies and industries. Manage the full sales cycle for export accounts \- lead

generation, inquiry management, quoting, negotiation, and order closure. Build and

maintain strong relationships with international buyers, distributors, and OEMs. Track and

respond to export RFQs in a timely and competitive manner.

3\. Pricing:

o Own end\-to\-end pricing decisions for the business, balancing competitiveness with margin

objectives. Develop pricing models and cost structures for various fastener and fitting

product types (standard and custom), factoring in material, processing, freight, duties, and

other landed cost components. Benchmark pricing against market/competitor data and adjust

strategy to win business profitably.

4\. Strategic Sourcing \& Vendor Development:

o Identify, evaluate, and onboard reliable manufacturing/supply partners for fasteners

and fittings (domestic and/or international, as required). Negotiate commercial terms

with suppliers to ensure cost competitiveness and quality/delivery reliability.

Continuously evaluate the supplier base for cost\-saving opportunities, alternate

sourcing options, and risk mitigation. Work closely with quality and production teams

(where applicable) to ensure supplier output meets customer specifications.

5\. Data Management \& Meticulousness:

o Maintain and continuously update business data \- customer pipeline, pricing history,

supplier cost data, and order tracking. Set up scalable processes and systems for the

business as it grows, laying the foundation for a larger team over time. Track business

performance against targets and report progress to leadership.

Required Qualifications Skills:

\* Education:

o Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field (Mechanical/Industrial

Engineering background is a plus but not mandatory).

\* Experience:

o At least 5\-7 years of experience in business development / inside sales within the

fasteners and fittings industry (or closely related industrial/hardware products).

Demonstrated experience in export business development, including handling

international customers, quoting, and export documentation/processes. Strong

working knowledge of fasteners and fittings products, applications, and industry

pricing dynamics. Prior exposure to sourcing/procurement of these products, with the

ability to negotiate with suppliers and manage supplier relationships. Experience

owning a P\&L, revenue target, or business unit outcome (formally or informally) is

highly preferred.

\* Skills:

o Strong commercial acumen, comfortable owning pricing and sourcing decisions, not just

sales targets. Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to engage both

international customers and domestic suppliers. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other

data/pricing analysis tools. Self\-starter mindset with high ownership, comfortable operating

with ambiguity in a build\-from\-scratch environment. Ability to work under pressure, manage

multiple priorities, and meet deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications:

o Prior experience building or scaling a new product category/business line

o Existing network of export customers and/or suppliers in the fasteners and fittings space.

What This Role Offers:

o This is a high\-ownership, high\-responsibility role ideal for someone who wants to grow their

career by running a business, not just a business development person. The successful

candidate will have significant autonomy to shape strategy, pricing, and sourcing, with the

challenge and reward of building something from the ground up

Pay: ₹600,000\.00 \- ₹1,200,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

As a Principal Engineering Manager on the **Azure Native Integrations team**, you will lead a team responsible for foundational platform and services that make it effortless for customers to discover, provision, and operate best\-in\-class partner (ISV) offerings natively within Azure/ Foundry. These Integrations focuses on delivering a first\-class, unified experience—spanning identity, billing, provisioning, and management—so partner services feel like a natural extension of the Microsoft platform across the portal, SDKs, and APIs, operating at significant scale and complexity. We work with large Enterprise technology provider ISVS across multiple categories: Observability, Data and Storage, Networks, Security, AI. Our work spans partner integration platforms, provisioning and control\-plane services, and the paved paths that enable teams to move quickly while maintaining reliability and security.

**We provide tooling, services, and operational support that allow partners and customers to onboard and run integrated services safely and efficiently. In this role you will set up the technical vision and own the end\-to\-end strategy for two critical charters: Azure Native Partner integration experience, and an AI\-based, agentic solution that automates and orchestrates onboarding and maintainability.** The team plays a critical role in maintaining trust in Azure's partner ecosystem while balancing speed, scale, security, and stability.

As a Principal Engineering Manager in this role, you will lead a team operating mission\-critical systems in a fast\-moving environment. You'll work closely with engineers and partners across the company to reduce onboarding friction, improve service reliability, respond to incidents, and evolve our AI\-driven platforms to meet the needs of a rapidly scaling partner ecosystem. jobs.title: Lead Product Owner
jobs.description:
The Lead Product Owner (LPO) within Kroll’s Chief Data Office (CDO) is responsible for
 **end‑to‑end ownership, consistency, and execution excellence across multiple data, analytics, and reporting products or domains** 
 . This role ensures alignment between business priorities, product strategy, and delivery execution.
   

  

 The Lead Product Owner acts as the
 **central accountability point across a portfolio of related products** 
 , coaching and guiding Product Owners, establishing standards, and partnering closely with Program Management, Data Engineering, and Governance to deliver predictable, high‑quality outcomes.
   

  

 This role is critical to enabling
 **product‑led execution at scale** 
 within the CDO.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Portfolio‑Level Product Ownership**
* Own the overall product vision and execution strategy across a defined product portfolio or domain (e.g., Reporting, Self‑Service Analytics, Finance Analytics, Data Platforms).
* Ensure each product has:
+ A clear purpose and roadmap
+ Defined success metrics
+ Consistent experience and standards

* Act as the final decision authority on prioritization, scope tradeoffs, and acceptance across related products.


**Leadership \& Coaching**
* Lead, mentor, and coach Product Owners to ensure consistent product ownership practices and decision quality.
* Set and enforce standards for backlog quality, roadmap clarity, and stakeholder communication.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex prioritization, dependency, or scope conflicts.
* Raise the overall product ownership maturity across CDO.


**Stakeholder Alignment \& Business Partnership**
* Serve as an interface between CDO and business, finance, and functional leaders for assigned domains.
* Translate enterprise priorities into sequenced, realistic roadmaps.
* Manage competing stakeholder demands by making transparent, value‑based trade‑offs.
* Ensure stakeholders have confidence in what will be delivered, when, and why.


**Roadmap, Backlog \& Delivery Governance**
* Maintain a portfolio‑level roadmap, aligned with capacity, dependencies, and strategic priorities.
* Ensure Product Owners maintain well‑defined, ready backlogs that support predictable delivery.
* Partner with Program Managers and Scrum Masters to:
+ Align sprint and release plans
+ Surface risks and constraints early
+ Manage cross‑team dependencies

* Ensure delivery adheres to CDO governance, readiness, and release standards.


**Quality, Governance \& Trust**
* Partner with Data Governance, Architecture, and Platform teams to:
+ Enforce consistent KPI definitions and semantic standards
+ Uphold data quality, lineage, and trust expectations
+ Ensure security and compliance requirements are met

* Ensure products are operationally ready and supported post‑release.


**Value Realization \& Continuous Improvement**
* Define and track adoption, usage, and value metrics across the product portfolio.
* Ensure products deliver measurable business impact, not just functionality.
* Identify opportunities to:
+ Simplify or consolidate products
+ Reduce technical or vendor dependency
+ Improve scalability and user experience

* Continuously refine product direction based on feedback and performance insights.


**Required**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 7\+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, Business Analysis, or Analytics/Data‑centric leadership roles.
* Proven experience owning multiple products or domains in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data, analytics, reporting, and BI platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with senior business stakeholders and technical delivery teams.
* Experience leading or mentoring other Product Owners or equivalent roles.


**Preferred**
* Experience within a Chief Data Office, Analytics COE, or Enterprise Reporting organization.
* Familiarity with platforms such as Databricks, Power BI, semantic models, and self‑service analytics.
* Experience modernizing legacy reporting or analytics platforms.
* Background in professional services or financial services environments.


**Leadership Behaviors \& Expectations**
* Thinks and acts portfolio‑first, not story‑by‑story.
* Brings clarity, structure, and discipline to ambiguity.
* Comfortable making—and defending—trade‑off decisions.
* Focused on outcomes, adoption, and trust, not just delivery.
* Acts as a role model for product ownership maturity.


**Role Relationships (Clarity of Accountability)**
* Lead Product Owner: Defines long‑term strategy, investment priorities, and value realization. Owns execution alignment, product standards, and delivery outcomes across a portfolio.
* Product Owners: Own day‑to‑day product execution and backlogs within specific domains.
* Program Managers: Own delivery coordination, milestones, and dependency management.


**Why This Role Matters**
 The Lead Product Owner ensures CDO can
 **scale product‑led execution without chaos** 
 , reducing reliance on individual heroics while increasing predictability, trust, and impact across enterprise data and analytics investments.

jobs.title: Principal Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Description**
 Synaptics is leading the charge in AI at the Edge, bringing AI closer to end users and transforming how we engage with intelligent connected devices, whether at home, at work, or on the move. As the go\-to partner for the world’s most forward\-thinking product innovators, Synaptics powers the future with its cutting\-edge Synaptics Astra™ AI\-Native embedded compute, Veros™ wireless connectivity, and multimodal sensing solutions. We’re making the digital experience smarter, faster, more intuitive, secure, and seamless. From touch, display, and biometrics to AI\-driven wireless connectivity, video, vision, audio, speech, and security processing, Synaptics is the force behind the next generation of technology enhancing how we live, work, and play.
   

  

**Overview**
 Synaptics is looking for a Principal Program Manager to join our Global Operations team. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in semiconductor design and manufacturing processes, coupled with exceptional program management skills. As the ASIC Program Manager, you will oversee the entire product lifecycle from concept through production, working closely with cross\-functional teams including design, verification, validation, and manufacturing to ensure timely delivery of high\-quality ASICs. The successful candidate will play a key project leadership role, acting as the primary owner of SOC program execution on the project planning scheduling, inter\-team coordination, status tracking and reporting. Sr. Director, Program Management.
   

  

**Responsibilities \& Competencies**
 Job Duties
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end program management of engineering programs from idea to mass production including planning, scoping, design, development, and change management
* Lead and coordinate all aspects of ASIC development programs from requirements gathering through to final product release, including design, verification, validation, and production rampup
* Work closely with internal engineering teams (ASIC design, firmware, validation, etc.), external partners, and vendors to manage deliverables and ensure alignment on project goals and schedules
* Support the teams in issue resolution and risk mitigation through well balanced and efficient processes leveraging tools and automation
* Actively support sustainable, effective cross\-functional communication at multiple levels in the organization
* Analyze technical issues and lead the team in generating creative mitigation options and solutions
* Act as the primary point of contact between engineering, product management, and senior leadership, providing regular status updates on program progress, issues, and risk management
* Monitor and manage the program budget, ensuring projects are delivered within financial constraints
* Manage relationships with operation team and external ASIC vendors, ensuring that they meet technical and delivery requirements
* Ensure proper documentation of program processes, designs, and decisions throughout the ASIC development lifecycle
* Drive continuous improvement of all processes, methodologies, and systems


 Competencies
   

  

* Well organized with strong attention to data and detail; proactively ensures work is accurate
* Ability to ask difficult but important questions and drive discussion to find answers
* Ability to influence horizontally across multiple internal functional organizations
* Developing talent, ability to inspire and excite team
* Highly structured planner with a strong discipline towards pragmatic and efficient processes
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with expertise in agile execution and facilitating multiple projects simultaneously
* Ability to synthesize and report complex matters simply for senior and executive management to grasp quickly
* Good verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work within a diverse team


**Qualifications (Requirements)**
* Bachelor's (Master’s preferred) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field or equivalent
* A deep understanding of ASIC design, verification, and manufacturing processes is essential.
* 15\+ years of experience in Program Management, including 5\+ years of expertise in engineering program management Experience in rigorous life\-cycle management including capturing requirements, decomposition, architecture, design, unit testing and integration testing among others
* Proven expertise in planning tools and methodologies (Jira, MS Project / SCRUM, waterfall)
* Hands\-on technical experience preferred
* No travel required


*Belief in Diversity
   

  

 Synaptics is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to workforce diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, or genetic information.*

As an Associate/ Senior Associate on the Global Banking Intelligence \& Growth Strategy team, you will play a critical role in advancing revenue growth across the Commercial \& Investment Bank. This team operates in a fast\-paced, insight\-driven environment, combining internal data, external market intelligence, and advanced analytical techniques—including AI and large language models—to identify high\-impact opportunities across M\&A, capital markets, FX, payments, and corporate banking. You will partner directly with senior business leaders to shape strategic priorities and enable more targeted, data\-driven revenue growth strategies.


**Job Responsibilities**


* Identify actionable global banking opportunities such as sell\-side M\&A, take\-private situations, and IPO candidates by integrating internal client indicators with external deal activity, valuation signals, and sector dynamics
* Develop market and product insights by analyzing proprietary payment flows, public filings, and external data sources to uncover FX hedging, capital markets, and broader corporate finance opportunities
* Create market sizing, total addressable market (TAM), wallet, and share\-of\-wallet models to guide banker focus and inform strategic prioritization
* Monitor market, sector, and capital markets developments to generate timely insights that influence client engagement and product strategy
* Design and enhance banker coverage models, prioritization frameworks, and territory strategies to optimize resource deployment and improve revenue productivity
* Design and build analytical workflows, dashboards, and opportunity assessments that support banker decision\-making at scale
* Drive complex analytical and strategic problem\-solving efforts and translate outputs into concise, actionable recommendations for executive audiences

* Lead initiatives from ideation through execution ensuring analytical rigor, clarity of outcomes, and alignment with business objectives

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills**


* 5\+ years of experience with a leading management consulting firm, top\-tier bank, or private equity firm with a focus on data\-driven strategy and advanced analytics development
* Demonstrated expertise in revenue\-driven analytics, market sizing, TAM and wallet modeling, and capital markets data analysis
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, including hands\-on experience with large datasets, financial statements, public filings, and AI/LLM tools for insight generation

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Workforce Strategy and Planning
jobs.description:
**About The Role**
 The Workforce Planning team within Customer Engagement Services (CES) ensures the right staffing at the right time to support Walmart’s customer care operations. As a Senior Analyst, you will be responsible for running the day\-to\-day forecasting processes, building capacity models, tracking trends, and identifying risks and opportunities within your assigned vertical. You will work closely with the Workforce Planning Manager, operations leaders, and cross\-functional partners to ensure forecasts accurately reflect business realities and translate into executable staffing plans.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 Build and maintain short\- and long\-term demand forecasts using historical data, business inputs, and trend analysis.
   

  

 Develop detailed capacity plans aligned to forecasted demand, productivity assumptions, and service level targets.
   

  

 Monitor business trends, performance metrics, and forecast accuracy to proactively identify risks or variances.
   

  

 Conduct root cause analysis on forecast variances and recommend tactical adjustments.
   

  

 Partner with operations to ensure capacity plans translate into actionable staffing strategies.
   

  

 Support scenario planning and surge\-readiness efforts by modeling volume and staffing impacts.
   

  

 Maintain forecasting hygiene, documentation, and assumption tracking to ensure transparency and repeatability.
   

  

 Provide regular reporting and insights on forecast performance, emerging trends, and staffing outlooks.
   

  

 Collaborate with data science and business stakeholders to incorporate new drivers, initiatives, or process changes into forecasts.
   

  

 Continuously refine models and tools to improve accuracy, efficiency, and scalability.
   

  

 What You'll Bring
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Industrial Engineering, Operations, or related field.
   

  

 4–7\+ years of experience in forecasting, workforce planning, capacity modeling, or operational analytics.
   

  

 Strong analytical and modeling skills with advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with workforce management tools.
   

  

 Ability to interpret data trends and translate them into clear, tactical staffing implications.
   

  

**Experience Supporting Contact Center Or Retail Operations Preferred.**
 Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple data inputs and deadlines.
   

  

 Clear communication skills with the ability to present findings to operations partners and leadership.
   

  

 A proactive mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and operational excellence.
   

  

**About Walmart Global Tech**
 Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. Were a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity experts and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people\-led and tech\-empowered. We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
   

  

 Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our \[Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
   

  

 Benefits:
   

  

 Benefits Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best\-in\-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
   

  

  

  

 Belonging
   

  

 We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
   

  

 At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity Employer
   

  

 Walmart, Inc., is an Equal Opportunities Employer – By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people.
